name: 3d-typo-edit
description: Motor de edits de tipografia 3D (neon / candy) com Three.js renderizado frame a frame em Chromium headless + ffmpeg.

scripts.demo: node engine/cli/demo-beat.mjs projects/demo-neon/beat.wav 15 && node engine/cli/render.mjs projects/demo-neon/scene.json --preview
scripts.demo:candy: node engine/cli/demo-beat.mjs projects/demo-candy/beat.wav 13 && node engine/cli/render.mjs projects/demo-candy/scene.json --preview
